config.discovery: Original H533 eight pairs per task only. Fit majority sign of unweighted token-identity map and routing coefficient separately, per task/head. Save signs before fresh analysis/intervention.
config.fresh_design: Eight new lexical pairs per task x three formats; no new head selection. Native competence reported per format, all retained pairs included.
config.gate: At least four pairs, >=75% both-endpoint candidate correctness, >=50% full-vocabulary top1.
config.decomposition: Unweighted core = output_head @ (initial value_after-initial value_before). Identity alignment = (unembedding_after-unembedding_before) dot core. Coefficient = native attention pattern summed over changed source positions * bus_mix. Residual gain for frozen final effect reported separately.
config.causal_test: Add the donor-minus-native persistent-bus contribution of one selected head at the last attention destination, then let all downstream computation run normally. Also inject each of two absent tokens into those source positions in this one head and compare their output margins.
config.third_test: Output margin for third0 minus third1 under injection third0 minus that margin under injection third1. Positive means identity copying; negative means suppression. Neither third token is a declared task answer.
config.scope: Head/source interventions, not replacement of all bus uses. No necessity or population claim.
